GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.6 (22 Nov 45) AG-E
(SCAPIN - 332)
22 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Destruction of Prisoner of War Records.
Information received at this headquarters indicates that certain records and documents regarding Allied prisoners of war were destroyed by the Japanese Army and Navy Departments. A complete list of all documents and records destroyed, together with the name and position of the individuals directing such destruction will be furnished this headquarters not later than 15 December 1945.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
